attendance_policy: Each student is expected to attend all classes and participate in all evaluation components. The “In-class/lab Assignment” from pre-MID assessment component will be conducted either on lecture session and/or in lab session. The assignment date will be announced at least one day prior and an absence in the same will lead to zero marks for that assignment. These assignments are linked with your attendance in class. No makeup assignments/quizzes are allowed. Please refer to the Makeup Policy section for more information.
makeup_policy: Makeup is applicable strictly for Mid-Sem or comprehensive exam only for cases related Emergency medical situations in campus. The medical documents (prescription/certificates etc.) prepared/attested by BITS Medical Centre, clearly specifying “the student is unfit to attend the test”, will be essential and non-negotiable. The final decision will be at the discretion of the IC.
